units.source_text: 他背过身，像陷进去似的坐在门槛上，抱着脑袋，不出声地呻吟起来。

en.t: He turned his back and sat on the threshold as though sinking into it, clutching his head and beginning to groan without making a sound.

units.source_text: 他想把囤积在嘴里的唾液咽下去，喉咙口一个劲儿地拒绝，他不知如何是好。

en.t: He tried to swallow the saliva that had gathered in his mouth, but his throat kept refusing, and he did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 喉咙口的黏膜，似乎对沙子的味道和气味特别敏感，时间再久也无法习惯。

en.t: The membrane at the back of his throat seemed especially sensitive to the taste and smell of sand, and no amount of time could make him used to it.

units.source_text: 唾液成了泛起冒泡的褐色疙瘩，从嘴唇里喷出来。

en.t: The saliva turned into foaming brown lumps and sprayed out from between his lips.

units.source_text: 吐掉唾沫，嘴里更明显地感到满口皆是粗糙的沙子。

en.t: After spitting out the saliva, he felt even more clearly that his mouth was filled with coarse sand.

units.source_text: 他极想把沙子吐出来，用舌头尖舔着口腔里侧，不断地吐着口水，简直像无底似的。

en.t: He desperately wanted to spit the sand out, licking the inside of his mouth with the tip of his tongue and spitting again and again, as though there were no end to it.

units.source_text: 最后，嘴里空荡荡的，竟火辣辣地刺痛起来，像是要发作炎症似的。

en.t: At last his mouth was empty, yet it began to sting with a burning pain, as if inflammation were about to set in.
